Kyurem

Dragon Ice

Unova · Generation 5 · Legendary Pokémon

Kyurem is a Dragon/Ice-type Boundary Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 3 m tall and weighs 325 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Attack (130), with a base stat total of 660.
